arxiv-1803-09205.title: Updating the MACHO fraction of the Milky Way dark halo with improved mass models 2018 Updating the MACHO fraction of the Milky Way dark halo with improved mass models – 13
arxiv-1803-09205.creator: Josh Calcino, Juan García-Bellido, Tamara M. Davis
arxiv-1803-09205.description: Abstract Recent interest in primordial black holes as a possible dark matter candidate has motivated the reanalysis of previous methods for constraining massive astrophysical compact objects in the Milky Way halo and beyond. In order to derive these constraints, a model for the dark matter distribution around the Milky Way must be used.

arxiv-2010-14123.title: Event Detection: Gate Diversity and Syntactic Importance Scores for Graph Convolution Neural Networks
arxiv-2010-14123.creator: Viet Dac Lai, Tuan Ngo Nguyen, Thien Huu Nguyen
arxiv-2010-14123.description: Abstract Recent studies on event detection (ED) have shown that the syntactic dependency graph can be employed in graph convolution neural networks (GCN) to achieve state-of-the-art performance. However, the computation of the hidden vectors in such graph-based models is agnostic to the trigger candidate words, potentially leaving irrelevant information for the trigger candidate for event prediction.

arxiv-2207-04379.title: Periodic points of a p p -adic operator and their p p -adic Gibbs measures
arxiv-2207-04379.creator: U. A. Rozikov, I. A. Sattarov, A. M. Tukhtabaev
arxiv-2207-04379.description: Abstract . In this paper we investigate generalized Gibbs measure (GGM) for p p -adic Hard-Core(HC) model with a countable set of spin values on a Cayley tree of order k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 . This model is defined by p p -adic parameters λ i \lambda_{i} , i ∈ ℕ i\in\mathbb{N} .

arxiv-2208-14355.title: Towards robust music source separation on loud commercial music
arxiv-2208-14355.description: Abstract Nowadays, commercial music has extreme loudness and heavily compressed dynamic range compared to the past. Yet, in music source separation, these characteristics have not been thoroughly considered, resulting in the domain mismatch between the laboratory and the real world. In this paper, we confirmed that this domain mismatch negatively affect the performance of the music source separation networks.

arxiv-2212-05451.title: OSC-MC: Online Secure Communication Model for Cloud Environment
arxiv-2212-05451.creator: Deepika Saxena, Ashutosh Kumar Singh
arxiv-2212-05451.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Deepika Saxena, Ashutosh Kumar Singh. A malicious cloud user may exploit outsourced data involved in online communication, co-residency, and hypervisor vulnerabilities to breach and hamper sensitive information, and inject malicious traffic based congestion, rendering services to other benign users. To address this critical and challenging problem, this letter proposes an Online Secure Communication Model for Cloud (OSC-MC) by identifying and terminating malicious VMs and inter-VM links prior to occurrence of security threats.

arxiv-2410-06087.title: The QED nonfactorizable correction to the semileptonic charmed three-body B B decays
arxiv-2410-06087.creator: Yueling Yang, Liting Wang, Jiazhi Li, Qin Chang, Junfeng Sun
arxiv-2410-06087.description: Abstract In this paper, the nonfactorizable photonic corrections to the effective four-fermion vertex for the B ¯ \overline{B} → {\to} D ( ∗ ) D^{({\ast})} + + ℓ − {\ell}^{-} + + ν ¯ ℓ \bar{\nu}_{\ell} decays are considered at the quark level within SM, where ℓ {\ell} = = e e , μ {\mu} and τ {\tau} .

arxiv-2504-08146.title: Development and Performance Analysis of Glass-Based Gas-Tight RPCs for Muography Applications
arxiv-2504-08146.creator: S. Ikram, S. Basnet, E. Cortina Gil, P. Demin, R.M.I.D. Gamage, A. Giammanco, R. Karnam, V. K. S. Kashyap, V. Kumar, B. Mohanty, M. Moussawi, A. Samalan, M. Tytgat
arxiv-2504-08146.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. Ikram, S. Basnet, E. Cortina Gil, P. Demin, R.M.I.D. Gamage, A. Giammanco, R. Karnam, V. K. S. Kashyap, V. Kumar, B. Mohanty, M. Moussawi, A. Samalan, M. Tytgat. To achieve high-resolution muography of compact targets in scenarios with complex logistical constraints, we are developing a portable muon detector system utilizing glass Resistive Plate Chambers (RPCs).

arxiv-2505-08657.title: A Comparative Study of Human Activity Recognition: Motion, Tactile, and multi-modal Approaches
arxiv-2505-08657.creator: Valerio Belcamino, Nhat Minh Dinh Le, Quan Khanh Luu, Alessandro Carfì, Van Anh Ho, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni
arxiv-2505-08657.description: Abstract Human activity recognition (HAR) is essential for effective Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC), enabling robots to interpret and respond to human actions. This study evaluates the ability of a vision-based tactile sensor to classify 15 activities, comparing its performance to an IMU-based data glove. Additionally, we propose a multi-modal framework combining tactile and motion data to leverage their complementary strengths.

arxiv-2508-16556.title: Spherical latent space models for social network analysis
arxiv-2508-16556.creator: Juan Sosa, Carlos Nosa
arxiv-2508-16556.description: Abstract This article introduces a spherical latent space model for social network analysis, embedding actors on a hypersphere rather than in Euclidean space as in standard latent space models. The spherical geometry facilitates the representation of transitive relationships and community structure, naturally captures cyclical patterns, and ensures bounded distances, thereby mitigating degeneracy issues common in traditional approaches.

arxiv-2512-14793.title: Be and Be-related impurities in diamond: density functional theory study
arxiv-2512-14793.creator: K. M. Etmimi ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, M. A. Ojalah ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, A. M. Abotruma ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}
arxiv-2512-14793.description: Abstract First-principles density functional simulations were employed to investigate the geometries, electrical properties, and hyperfine structures of various beryllium-doped diamond configurations, including interstitial (Be i ), substitutional (Be s ), and beryllium-nitrogen (Be-N) complexes. The incorporation of Be into the diamond lattice is more favorable as a substitutional dopant than as an interstitial dopant, although both processes are endothermic.

arxiv-2604-04912.creator: Sobyasachi Chatterjee, Sushmita Gupta, Saket Saurabh, Sanjay Seetharaman, Anannya Upasana

britannica-1911-athos.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-athos.description: Article 'Athos' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Owing to the timely submission of the monks to the Turks after the capture of Salonica (1430), their privileges were respected by successive sultans: a tribute is paid to the Turkish government, which is represented by a resident kaimakam, and the community is allowed to maintain a small police force.

doe-osti-3000976-tracking-carbon-dioxide.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. pmc-10501709.title: Building bridges: multidisciplinary teams in tuberculosis prevention and care
pmc-10501709.creator: João Pedro Ramos, Mariana Vieira, Cátia Pimentel, Mariana Argel, Pedro Barbosa, Raquel Duarte
pmc-10501709.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). People with or affected by tuberculosis (TB) experience complex social and cultural constraints that may affect treatment outcomes by impeding access to proper care or by hindering treatment adherence. Low levels of health literacy which leads to inadequate disease information; stigma, discrimination and other forms of prejudice that may result in marginalisation and ostracisation; and socioeconomic vulnerabilities that hamper one's capacity to access essential goods or increase the risk of exposure to the disease are some of the barriers highlighted.

pmc-10544467.title: Gender differences in transdiagnostic domains and function of adults measured by DSM-5 assessment scales at the first clinical visit: a cohort study
pmc-10544467.creator: Erika F.H. Saunders, Megan Brady, Dahlia Mukherjee, Ritika Baweja, Lauren N. Forrest, Hassaan Gomaa, Dara Babinski, Fan He, Amanda M. Pearl, Duanping Liao, Daniel A. Waschbusch
pmc-10544467.description: BackgroundMeasurement-based care has been called for as best practice in psychiatric care and learning health systems and use of transdiagnostic measures was suggested as part of the DSM-5. Our objective is to examine gender differences in first visit socioeconomic, transdiagnostic, and functional characteristics of a dynamic, real-world measurement-based care cohort.

pmc-11507117.title: Analyzing Social Support from Facebook on Viral Suppression among Young Black Men Who Have Sex with Men Living with HIV: A Pilot Study
pmc-11507117.creator: Eleanor E Friedman, Natascha Del Vecchio, Joseph A Mason, Samantha A Devlin, Jessica P Ridgway, John A Schneider, Jimmy T Efird
pmc-11507117.description: Social support has been associated with viral suppression among persons living with HIV (PWH). We examined cross-sectional data from young Black men who have sex with men to see if sociodemographic factors, medical history, and egocentric Facebook social support measures are related to viral suppression.

pmc-11546679.title: Data on the crystal structures of β-glucosidase from Thermoanaerobacterium saccharolyticum
pmc-11546679.creator: Ki Hyun Nam
pmc-11546679.description: β-Glucosidase (Bgl) is a biomass-degrading enzyme that hydrolyzes cellobiose and glucose-substituted polysaccharides into glucose, playing a crucial role in enzymatic saccharification during biofuel production. Despite the wealth of structural information available on Bgl, the molecular properties of the loops above the substrate-binding pocket remain unexplored.

pmc-11557390.title: Reinforcement learning in motor skill acquisition: using the reward positivity to understand the mechanisms underlying short- and long-term behavior adaptation
pmc-11557390.creator: Mariane F. B. Bacelar, Keith R. Lohse, Juliana O. Parma, Matthew W. Miller
pmc-11557390.description: IntroductionAccording to reinforcement learning, humans adjust their behavior based on the difference between actual and anticipated outcomes (i.e., prediction error) with the main goal of maximizing rewards through their actions. Despite offering a strong theoretical framework to understand how we acquire motor skills, very few studies have investigated reinforcement learning predictions and its underlying mechanisms in motor skill acquisition.

pmc-11609121.title: Trajectory priming through obstacle avoidance in motor imagery – does motor imagery comprise the spatial characteristics of movement?
pmc-11609121.creator: James W Roberts, Caroline J Wakefield, Robin Owen
pmc-11609121.description: Motor imagery and execution often indicate a similar trend in the temporal characteristics of movements. This finding supports the notion of functional equivalence, whereby imagery and execution use a common neural representation. However, there is comparatively limited evidence related to the spatial characteristics of movements; no doubt owing to the absence of an actual spatial trajectory during imagery.

pmc-11652114.title: Sex‐Specific Variation in Foraging Behavior is Related to Telomere Length in a Long‐Lived Seabird
pmc-11652114.creator: Mauricio Guillen‐Parra, Rocio Barcenas‐Flores, Alberto Velando, Anne Wiley, Bibiana Montoya, Roxana Torres
pmc-11652114.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Foraging during breeding is a demanding activity linked to breeding investment and possibly constrained by individual quality. Telomere length, the protective nucleoproteins located at the ends of the chromosomes, is considered a trait reflecting somatic maintenance and individual quality. Therefore, foraging effort and parental investment may be positively related to telomere length, if individuals with longer telomeres are of better quality and thus able to maintain better body condition and allocate more resources to parental activities.

pmc-11694048.title: Intestinal Colonization of Multidrug-Resistant Organisms: Identification and Antibiotic Susceptibility Patterns of Bacteria Isolated From Healthy Human Fecal Specimens
pmc-11694048.creator: Vishnu Vandana Waddepally, Sofiya Rabye, Ryhana Bashir, Venkataramana Kandi
pmc-11694048.description: IntroductionIntestinal carriage of multidrug-resistant organisms (MDROs) in healthy populations could amplify resistant bacteria, which may increase the risk of infections by these bacteria in the community and in the hospital. This study investigated the prevalence of colonization of multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria in the intestines of healthy individuals in South India.

pmc-12609364.title: Red Blood Cell Fatty Acid Patterns and Cognitive Functions in Adolescents: A Pooled Analyses with Two Cohort Study Data Sets
pmc-12609364.creator: Nicolas Ayala-Aldana, Ariadna Pinar-Martí, Marina Ruiz-Rivera, Iolanda Lázaro, Aleix Sala-Vila, Darren R Healy, Oren Contreras-Rodriguez, Jordi Casanova, Nuria Sola-Valls, Martine Vrijheid, Jordi Julvez, Yuanzhong Xu
pmc-12609364.description: Objective: Fatty acids (FAs) play a pivotal role in brain development and cognitive functions during adolescence. We aimed to investigate the association of red blood cell (RBC) FA patterns and several high order neuropsychological functions in adolescents. Methods: The study followed a cross-sectional design.

pmc-13581500.title: Case Report: Proportionate short stature in a three-generation family harboring FGFR3 N540S: phenotypic expansion beyond hypochondroplasia and implications for genetic screening in idiopathic short stature
pmc-13581500.creator: Beibei Zhang, Xinmeng Wang, Jingjie Luo, Chunxiu Gong
